name: Reporting Asset Breakdown 2
definition: Specifies the breakdown of a reported amount that can be split across a range of assets: agency, cash, corporate, equity, municipal, sovereign, or another asset class.

ReportingAssetType.name: Reporting Asset Type
ReportingAssetType.definition: Class of the asset which is a component of the breakdown.

DebtIssuerType.name: Debt Issuer Type
DebtIssuerType.definition: Identifies the type of the issuer of a bond.

DebtIssuerTypeRule.definition: If ReportingAssetType is equal to value 'BOND', then DebtIssuerType must be present.

ConditionalPresenceOfBond.definition: The Debt Issuer Type must be present if and only if Financial Instrument Type equals 'Bond'
